transitions: DRAFT -> ACTIVE after explicit approval and dependency validation
active_meaning: Approved bounded concept/claim binding eligible for new compatible uses, not verified learner competence.
draft_use: Experimental draft artifacts only, never recommendation eligible.
deprecated_use: Read/replay only; no new recommendations; old IDs never deleted/reassigned.
dependencies: Exact acyclic releases; all active at activation; one defining owner per ID.
concept_relationship: SemanticPolicy interpretation policy; CapabilityPack definitions; existing DomainKnowledgePack normalization/hints. Linked, not interchangeable.
resolution_context: Proposed immutable SemanticResolutionContext pins existing role SemanticPolicy and its single normalization-pack binding, mapping policy and capability-pack releases. Current SemanticPolicy schema is not assumed to support capability packs.

roles.responsibility: Namespace ownership, definition invariants, cross-domain collision decisions

roles.authority: Existing SemanticPolicy API requires REVIEWER; taxonomy authority requires separate explicit assignment
Existing SME role is not automatic taxonomy authority

new_capability_policy.propose: Named source stewards/domain reviewers/owners; AI draft proposals untrusted
new_capability_policy.threshold: Business need plus at least two independently authored requirements/outcomes across sources, or one authoritative standard plus independent internal use; bounded scope/exclusions/evidence and collision review.
new_capability_policy.approve: Namespace/domain owner and independent semantic reviewer; named assignments required before activation.
